data.title: TSD blocks cyber threat after Investor Portal data leak
data.description: Thailand Securities Depository has contained a data leak on its Investor Portal and notified regulators and potentially affected users

data.title: Emerging markets drive global central bank gold buying in May
data.description: World Gold Council data show central banks added 41 tonnes of gold in May, with Poland leading purchases and China extending its buying run.

data.title: Island cracks down on jet skis
data.description: PHUKET: Phuket authorities have taken legal action against eight jet ski operators following a province-wide inspection campaign targeting unlicensed businesses and illegal foreign nominee arrangements.

data.title: Man wanted over attack in Narathiwat
data.description: A court has issued an arrest warrant for a suspect in the deadly Narathiwat checkpoint attack as Defence Minister Lt Gen Adul Boonthumjaroen pledged to bring those responsible to justice.

data.title: Convincing start for Thailand
data.description: Thailand boss Anthony Hudson made clear that squad places will be decided purely on merit, after the seven-time regional champions opened their Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 Group B campaign in style with a comprehensive 5-0 victory over Laos in Vientiane on Saturday.

data.title: Port seal deal for striker Jude in final summer signing
data.description: Port have confirmed the arrival of Thai-English forward Jude Soonsup-Bell, closing out their transfer business ahead of a gruelling 2026-27 season that will see the club compete on five fronts.

data.title: Korean man cuffed over mule accounts
data.description: A South Korean man wanted under an Interpol Red Notice for allegedly supplying mule accounts to a call-centre gang has been arrested in Bangkok.

data.title: Witnesses lift lid on Senate vote claims
data.description: The opposition on Thursday presented new witness testimony alleging that last year's Senate election was rigged through a coordinated scheme in which candidates were recruited, instructed how to vote and offered payments.

data.title: Thais reject munitions claim
data.description: Thailand has rejected Cambodian claims that its military left nearly 3,900 square kilometres of border areas contaminated with unexploded cluster munitions, saying the figures were unverified and lacked independent forensic evidence.

data.title: Fighting the phone addiction scourge
data.description: Concerns over children's mental health is renewing debate whether excessive use of mobile devices is harming academic performance and learning capability, while boosting social isolation and criminal behaviour influenced by online personalities.

data.title: Amulet boom draws capital concerns
data.description: The Chinese visitors arrived with cameras, social-media teams and ambitious business plans. They travelled from temple to temple, rented display space, bought sacred objects and promised to introduce Thai spiritual products to millions of followers back home.

data.title: Russian crime boss faces extradition
data.description: PHUKET: A Russian man accused of leading an organised crime group has been arrested on the popular resort island on Saturday.

data.title: Italian pupils fined over skytrain row
data.description: Five Italian students were fined after settling a dispute with a Thai woman over their behaviour during a BTS Skytrain confrontation that drew widespread online criticism.

data.title: Crises beset the govt
data.description: Three months after taking office, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's administration is facing a sceptical public rather than enjoying the customary honeymoon period afforded to new governments.

data.title: LSD bust prompts warning to parents
data.description: Authorities have warned parents and schools to be vigilant after customs officers intercepted a shipment of LSD blotter paper printed with colourful cartoon designs that was allegedly destined for Thailand.

data.title: Welfare data to drive jobs push
data.description: The government plans to use data from its latest state welfare card registration to help more than five million working-age low-income people find jobs and improve their skills in a bid to address the root causes of poverty.

data.title: PM eyes redundant agencies
data.description: The government will begin dissolving a number of state agencies from September as part of a public sector reform programme aimed at eliminating overlapping responsibilities and improving administrative efficiency.

data.title: Norris grabs first race win of season in Hungary
data.description: BUDAPEST - Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix on Sunday ahead of Max Verstappen, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli recovered from a pre-race penalty to complete the podium in third.

data.title: Urgent search for suspect after deadly attack near Berlin Pride
data.description: BERLIN - German police on Sunday were hunting for the prime suspect in a car-ramming attack on the outskirts of Berlin Pride, which left one woman dead and 16 others injured.

data.title: Malaysia steps in to host Bahrain F1 GP in October
data.description: BUDAPEST - The Bahrain Grand Prix, which was cancelled in April due to the Middle East war, will be held in Malaysia in early October, Formula One organisers announced on Sunday.

data.title: Thai courier arrested in Japan, 'ice' in client's package
data.description: A family is seeking help after their daughter was arrested in Japan on suspicion of drug smuggling after crystal methamphetamine was allegedly discovered hidden inside coffee sachets contained in a parcel she was paid to carry there.

data.title: Wildfires overwhelm exhausted firefighters in France and Spain
data.description: BORDEAUX, France - Fire crews in France and Spain battling unchecked wildfires that have forced more than 300,000 people to flee were overwhelmed by the task on Sunday as the unpredictable blazes continued to spread.

data.title: D-Day Normandy beaches now Unesco heritage site
data.description: PARIS - ⁠The ⁠Normandy D-Day beaches ​where Allied forces landed on June ​6, 1944, ‌to fight Adolf Hitler's Nazi troops and go on to liberate France have become a Unesco protected world heritage site, ​the ⁠United Nations body said on Sunday.

data.title: Govt to begin abolishing redundant state agencies in Sept
data.description: The government will begin dissolving and merging state agencies with overlapping or obsolete functions from September, as part of a broader effort to streamline Thailand's public sector and improve competitiveness, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Tour van hits two vehicles on dangerous hill road
data.description: PHETCHABUN - A tour van had a brake malfunction, according to the driver, and hit two other vehicles, injuring six people, while descending Phu Thap Boek mountain in this northern province on Sunday.

data.title: Japan’s viral macaque Punch receives over 2,500 birthday cards
data.description: Supporters worldwide sent more than 2,500 cards to Ichikawa City Zoo, where visitors celebrated Punch’s growing ease within his troop.

data.title: Senate panel pushing Pha Taem, Sam Phan Bok onto global tourism map
data.description: UBON RATCHATHANI - A Senate committee has pledged support for improving transport links, tourism infrastructure and public information in Ubon Ratchathani, to raise the profile of Pha Taem National Park and strengthen Ubon Ratchathani Geopark's bid for Unesco Global Geopark status.

data.title: GROREIT moves to reclaim Royal Orchid asset after ROH misses buy-back deadline
data.description: ONE Asset Management says ROH has defaulted on its 4.873-billion-baht buy-back of the Royal Orchid Sheraton asset, ending its repurchase right and paving the way for valuation and a new auction.
